receipt.name: WarmBicubicResize

nativeBuild.purpose: Original development-only warm FFmpeg scaler backend worker

receipt.boundary: One resident original 513x259 RGBA8 raster to independently owned 64x32 bicubic output at the same sample depth. Complete public Resize, admission, allocation/materialization/disposal. FFmpeg zscale's zimg backend with B=0/C=0.5, encoded-space premultiplied filtering. TIMED complete packed-source deinterleaving, sixteen-pixel clamped halo (19.364% input-area increase), filtering, independent planar/packed output allocation, repacking and release. Explicit geometry uses premultiplied float output and TIMED straight RGBA quantization after unpremultiplication, clearing RGB when rounded alpha is zero. Graph/input-workspace/scratch contexts reused; every call processes every selected sample. Managed exact rational pixels; explicitly approved native-only RGB/alpha maximum1/RMSE0.25; normal/scalar bounded difference; zero-alpha RGBzero. This is the labeled scaler backend, not FFmpeg CLI. No output cache. Startup, IPC, I/O, generation and validation excluded; one CPU, normal SIMD, no concurrency. Only this geometry/depth is measured.
